labsPage.title: Labs
labsPage.intro: Work through these in order. Each lab lives under labs/ in the repo — open a terminal next to this page.

learn.serveHint: Serve the web/ folder over HTTP (for example python3 -m http.server 4173), then open the site from that URL.

lab.serveHint: Serve the web/ folder over HTTP.
lab.verifyBody: After finishing the steps in playground/, run the verifier from this lab folder:

01-first-repo.title: First repo
01-first-repo.summary: Init, stage, commit — your first real history.

02-branch-merge.title: Branch & merge
02-branch-merge.summary: Split work safely, then bring it back together.

03-conflict.title: Conflict
03-conflict.summary: Meet a merge conflict and resolve it calmly.

04-rebase.title: Rebase
04-rebase.summary: Replay commits and keep history readable.

05-undo.title: Undo
05-undo.summary: Restore, amend, reset, and revert with intent.

06-remote-pr.title: Remote & PR
06-remote-pr.summary: Push a branch and open a clean pull request.

07-team-workflow.title: Team workflow
07-team-workflow.summary: Ignore junk, sync often, write reviewable PRs.

08-stash.title: Stash
08-stash.summary: Shelf unfinished work, switch context, restore it.

09-tags.title: Tags
09-tags.summary: Annotate releases and check out a version tag.

10-cherry-pick.title: Cherry-pick
10-cherry-pick.summary: Bring one commit onto another branch.

11-interactive-rebase.title: Interactive rebase
11-interactive-rebase.summary: Squash messy commits into a clear story.

12-bisect.title: Bisect
12-bisect.summary: Binary-search history for the breaking commit.

13-internals.title: Internals
13-internals.summary: Walk commits, trees, blobs, and refs.

14-worktrees.title: Worktrees
14-worktrees.summary: Use detached HEAD safely and work in a second worktree.

15-inspect-history.title: Inspect history
15-inspect-history.summary: Trace changes with blame, pickaxe search, and branch ranges.

16-hooks.title: Hooks
16-hooks.summary: Install a pre-commit hook and see it catch a bad commit.

17-signing.title: Signing commits
17-signing.summary: Sign a commit with SSH and verify the signature locally.

18-forks.title: Forks & remotes
18-forks.summary: Add upstream on a fork, push a feature, and fetch when the original repo moves.

19-submodules-lfs.title: Submodules & LFS
19-submodules-lfs.summary: Pin a nested repo with a submodule, then track a large file with Git LFS.
